name: arthus reaction
defn: A localized vasculitis resulting from deposition of antibody-antigen complexes.

name: aseptic meningitis
defn: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord without a bacterial pathogen.

name: perinatal asphyxia
defn: A disorder caused by a lack of blood flow or gas exchange to or from the fetus in the period immediately before, during, or after the birth process.

name: atrial septal defect
defn: Interauricular communication is a congenital malformation characterized by a communication between the atrial chambers of the heart.

name: chronic atrophic gastritis
defn: Atrophic gastritis that is persistent and long-standing.

name: atrophy of thyroid
defn: Tissue degeneration and diminished size of the thyroid gland.

name: bacterial conjunctivitis
defn: Inflammation of the conjunctiva caused by a variety of bacterial agents.

name: bacterial endocarditis
defn: Endocarditis that is caused by an infection with a bacterial agent.
